build: OFFLINE with a stub Netlify CLI

results.name: default run is a dry run: checks pass, preserved file counted, the Netlify CLI is NOT called
--deploy calls the CLI for the existing site id WITHOUT --prod/--alias, deploys a temp copy that contains the preserved page, and reports a draft URL
results.actual: exit 0 call=deploy --dir /tmp/tmp.HV1zKWqacZ --site 48c18d02-eb99-46b4-a68d-96f724940fd9 --message staging draft 2026-11-06T18:29Z - L: https://6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f--incredible-biscotti-bcf58a.netlify.app (SSO-protected; the live site is unchanged)

results.name: the dist folder itself is not modified (preserved file only added to the temp copy)
refuses (exit 2, CLI never called): fixture build, other staging project, production-targeted build, production ref in a file, secret pattern, missing _headers
if the CLI result does not look like a draft URL (could be the live site), the script exits 4 and warns instead of claiming success
results.actual: exit 4 DEPLOYMENT FAILED: could not confirm a draft URL (got 'https://incredible-biscotti-bcf58a.netlify.ap

results.name: if the live site's published deploy id changes during a draft deploy, the script exits 5 and prints the rollback target
results.actual: exit 5 DEPLOYMENT FAILED SAFETY CHECK: the live site's published deploy changed (6adf6e4d0e82082a49c6f086 -> '6adf6e4d0e82082a49c6f099'). Roll back: Netlify > Deploys

results.name: a failing Netlify CLI gives exit 3 and a clear DEPLOYMENT FAILED message
results.actual: exit 3 DEPLOYMENT FAILED: Netlify CLI exit 7; the live site was not intentionally changed (checking...)

results.name: if the published deploy id cannot be read, deployment is refused BEFORE any deploy call
results.actual: exit 2 REFUSED: cannot read the site's currently published deploy id (CLI not logged in or wrong site?); re
